authority: read-only DungeonRuntime.publicState previous/next snapshots; NEVER writes HP, RNG, ticks, replay or movement

provenanceRules.swing: fresh attack action only; attempting actor can be known, hit and victim are NOT implied
provenanceRules.damage: victim HP genuinely decreases between consecutive same-scene public states no more than 5 ticks apart; never invent attacker
provenanceRules.verifiedMeleeDelay: 215 ms only when upstream matchIncomingLane can validate one same-tick adjacent melee source; does NOT prove causation
provenanceRules.rangedRelease: fresh attack with explicit targetId and legal grid/range/axis/wall resolver; no arrival hit effect
provenanceRules.spellRelease: fresh cast with explicit legal target; exclude same-tick healing/disarm and radial Warden attacks
provenanceRules.blockEvadeInterrupt: same-tick semantic event; unidentified block/interrupt have sound only, evade dust needs one witnessed single-cell displacement
provenanceRules.wardenWarning: active live Warden, public bossWarning truth, nonempty cells, attackTick equals currentTick plus remaining count
provenanceRules.wardenRelease: fresh Warden cast action; no inferred damaged victim or danger cell
provenanceRules.opening: public Warden opening event; no invented counterattack
provenanceRules.counter: public counter event AND observed Warden HP drop AND prior exposed recovery window
provenanceRules.defeat: fresh authoritative terminal event; never treat a disconnected browser as defeat

runtime.presentedFrameAcknowledgment: must follow a successful actual WebGL render submission; not proof of pixels encoded or sample arrival

visualResources.hitFragmentsPerVerifiedInjury: 4 to 6, never on miss or projectile arrival
visualResources.reducedMotion: suppress sword afterimage and moving dodge dust; preserve truth and genuine injury
visualResources.reducedFlash: all visual effect material alpha at most 0.25

audioResources.source: new authored procedural WebAudio; no external licensed samples, tracks, or microphone
audioResources.compressor: optional available-device protection only; integrated and true peaks still require measurement
audioResources.roles: whoosh is noise only; hit includes low thud; steel block includes inharmonic resonators
audioResources.materialRole: optional trusted renderer hint stone, steel, wood, cloth or neutral; never evidence of collision causation
audioResources.mute: stop active voices, clear pending, revoke opt-in, persist muted preference

acceptance: Requires D10 integration, actual same-seed running-game audiovisual capture and measured contact onset; 25 local contracts and original-foley audition do NOT establish 3D transformation or production readiness
